modinfo.title: CD Palmar Pill Limit 3/2
modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: Limits how many Palmar Pills you can carry: 3 Palmar Pill(s) and 2 Refined Palmar Pill(s) in total (vanilla 10 each). Lowers max_stack_count where needed and turns on apply_max_stack_cap (the total-carry cap the game uses for Refinement Tokens). Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Each change also carries entry + rel_offset so DMM can re-anchor it by record if a future patch moves things.

changes.label: Palmar Pill (RevivalItemPartialRecovery) apply_max_stack_cap: 0->1 (cap total held at 3)
Refined Palmar Pill (RevivalItem) apply_max_stack_cap: 0->1 (cap total held at 2)
